recap.headline: Eshan Called Himself Champion, Sits Fifth
recap.subhead: Thug Life posted the day's best box score, the Nova Knicks won the night, and MONSTARS found three new ways to lose it.

zingers.line: Eshan B picked himself to finish first, then Luka dropped 41 and his team still lost the night 6-4 to LeParth James.
Zero Fox Given walked away from a 7-1 beating by BrookynDynasty with nobody playing and a 1-7-3 night record.
MONSTARS took the day's worst night, 3-5-3 against Gopher Gold, and still collected the brick award for lazy decoration.
Thug Life led the league in points, OREB and DREB, and still lost the matchup to Adam Silver Dez Nuts, 7-4.
Victor Wembanyama went 14-21 with five blocks, and the Nova Knicks needed every one to bully theInfamous 6-4.
Jayson Tatum dropped 40 for theInfamous, who still went 4-6-1 on the night against a Wemby-powered Knicks team.
Michael Porter Jr. hit six threes for the White Mambas, who still sit 8-2 down to Suggs to be you.

night: Luka Dončić went off for Acinonyx: 41.0 PTS, 9.0 AST, 6.0 3PTM on 12-22 FG. His team still lost the night 6-4 to LeParth James.
Walker Kessler gave Thug Life 13.0 PTS and 8.0 REB on 6-9 FG, the dullest brick of a night when his team led the league in scoring.
No bench blunders surfaced last night: nobody left a monster on the pine, so every lineup mistake was committed on the roster itself.
De'Andre Hunter dropped 24.0 PTS and 5.0 3PTM on 8-13 FG, and he is still on the wire. Twelve managers looked at that and kept scrolling.
Nova Knicks won the night at 6-4-1 against theInfamous. MONSTARS ☄️ lost the night worst at 3-5-3 against Gopher Gold.
